objectives.statement: Understand foundational mental models and architecture of Cybersecurity
Implement secure, reproducible solutions across real-world Cybersecurity tasks
Diagnose common production edge cases, bottlenecks, and vulnerabilities in Cybersecurity
Architect scalable enterprise workflows aligned with Cybersecurity industry best practices

prerequisites: Basic familiarity with HTTP, Linux terminal commands, and web accounts

modules.title: Module 1: Security Principles & Network Defense
modules.summary: Master the CIA Triad, threat modeling (STRIDE), TLS/PKI transport trust, firewalls, and perimeter defense.
lessonTitles: CIA Triad, Threat Modeling & Attack Surface
Network Defense: Firewalls, Stateful Inspection & TLS 1.3
modules.checkpoint: Classify attack surfaces via STRIDE and design multi-layer network controls.

modules.title: Module 2: Authentication, Cryptography & OWASP AppSec
modules.summary: Implement safe Argon2 password hashing, hardened session cookies, RBAC/IDOR protection, and OWASP Top 10 defenses against SQLi/XSS.
lessonTitles: OWASP Top 10: Injection (SQLi), XSS & Cookie Hardening
modules.checkpoint: Patch injection, broken access control (IDOR), and insecure session storage vulnerabilities.

modules.title: Module 3: Security Operations (SOC) & Incident Response
modules.summary: Execute SOC access log triage, configure SIEM detection alerts, and step cleanly through the NIST Incident Response lifecycle.
lessonTitles: SOC Log Triage, SIEM Alerting & Anomaly Detection
NIST Incident Response Lifecycle & Hardening Capstone
modules.checkpoint: Detect brute-force & SQLi patterns in raw proxy logs and write actionable containment rules.

practiceActivities: Analyze raw web server logs to identify SQL injection and credential stuffing IPs
Replace vulnerable string-interpolated queries with parameterized prepared statements
Author hardened HTTP CSP / session cookie security policies
assessmentCheckpoints: Module 1: Security Principles & Network Defense Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
Module 2: Authentication, Cryptography & OWASP AppSec Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
Module 3: Security Operations (SOC) & Incident Response Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
projects: Defensive Security Operations Playbook: Log Triage, Hardened APIs & NIST IR Plan
proficiencyCriteria: Identify real threats across access logs and classify vulnerabilities via CIA / OWASP
Apply cryptographic hashing, TLS trust, and least-privilege controls cleanly
Execute containment and forensic preservation steps safely during incidents
